treatment_contract.created: try_create returns None for nonsemantic/no engine/unsupported compilation and catches compile Exceptions. This does not increment Runtime fallback counters.
treatment_contract.active: native_legality_enabled is final Runtime provider-present and active state, not all-frontier Native coverage.
treatment_contract.successful_calls: calls increments only after complete provider result validation; positive calls establish executed treatment, not full Native state/search/evaluation.
treatment_contract.state_capability: supports_position miss increments fallback without disabling provider or operational failure; enabled may remain1.
treatment_contract.failure: Non-strict operational failure increments fallback/failure and disables provider for later frontiers; final enabled0 can coexist with earlier positive calls.
treatment_contract.cancel: Checkpoint abort propagates; not an operational fallback.
treatment_contract.cached_terminal: Cached/terminal legality paths need no provider call; an available provider may legitimately show0calls.
treatment_contract.required_comparison_record: requested/compiled representation/provider creation/positive calls/actions/state fallbacks/operational failures/evaluator/q/history/source/budget, with missing counters unknown.
